WDS Fight Night 6 summary

WDS Fight Night 6 took place on 28 October 2023 at Fit & Fight Club, Nerul, Navi Mumbai. The card had 9 bouts (9 professional). 8 of the 9 decided bouts ended inside the distance by knockout, TKO or submission. In the main event, Nishant Karkera beat Thirubalachandran D by TKO in round 1.
